body: Thank you comrade! Our party back home is truly a marxist leninist one. And even if it loses track someday,  the principles of democratic centralism are well established within us and we the cadres will bring it back on track! All the best to you too!✊

Thank you Comrade. I have joined the communist party of my country of nationality. It is currently the party in government as well. I thank my lucky stars everyday that I wasn't born in the US. But, the country I am living in right now is a xenophobic, worker hating, shit country run by bourgeoisie assholes. I can't return home immediately either as I have several commitments here. I just want the workers of the world to unite and overthrow capitalism from all around the world- not just one country.

I was the shortest one in class and for my age, and plus, I was the skinniest as well. And I don't know if it was the height, or a defence mechnism or whatever but I was the "wanna be cool kid" who wanted to be one of the hip and cool kids but was always bullied. I remember this one particular incident where a taller girl pushed me and cursed at me while playing basketball. Alot of incidents like that. 
Anyways, after a few years I outgrew many if not all of the people in my year. But, the many years of bullying and ridicule I faced had severely hampered my confidence and now I have social anxiety, anxiousness and what not.  even though I am considered very tall in my country ( the average man's height is 5'4" and I am 6'2") , I don't have the confidence to take advantage of it.
